summary: Ran 9-endpoint pytest suite against Bajiman public URL and end-to-end Playwright UI tests. All 9 backend tests pass (health guard, health with key query+header, health ping=false, provider ping ok+IP whitelisted, login success, login bad creds, 9Wicket launch+cashout roundtrip, 9Wicket callback returns text 'OK'). Frontend loads within ~10s (site loader gates on redux `loaded`+`gameLoaded`, both fire once /api/global/client/site-data + game-data return). Login via UI works: modal opens from লগইন button, POST /api/users/login → 200, token saved to localStorage.user_token, navbar switches to show balance 2,000 BDT and avatar. However, navigating to /play-game/11539 renders 'Game not found' screen because PlayGame.jsx does a pre-launch lookup GET /api/global/client/play-game/11539 which 404s on the near-empty catalog and short-circuits the flow before /api/9wicket/launch is ever called. Navigating to /play-game/11539?uid=11539 skips the lookup and the game iframe renders with a real provider URL (https://igamingapis.live/9w/play?t=...). Provider IP is currently whitelisted.

integration_issues.issue: PlayGame.jsx (lines 89-102) calls GET /api/global/client/play-game/:gameId first. Catalog DB is empty so it returns 404 'Game not found'; the error is thrown, caught by the outer try/catch, and shown as the failure state. /api/9wicket/launch is never called. Root cause: no fallback to using the URL param as game_uid when the lookup returns 404. Works fine when /play-game/11539?uid=11539 is used (verified iframe src = https://igamingapis.live/9w/play?t=... after 400/200 launch sequence).

issues: Submit button remains grey/disabled-looking until both fields are filled (actual disabled state, not just style) — expected UX but worth confirming the greyed-out variant has enough contrast against the modal bg.

action_items: Fix client/src/pages/PlayGame/PlayGame.jsx: when GET /api/global/client/play-game/:gameId returns 404 (or any non-2xx), fall back to `resolvedGameUid = gameId` and continue to POST /api/9wicket/launch instead of surfacing 'Game not found'. Alternatively, when the numeric gameId matches a known provider game_uid (e.g. env WORLD_CASINO_9WICKET_GAME_UID), skip the catalog lookup entirely.
Optionally seed the games collection in MongoDB with at least the 11539 record so the lookup succeeds and game cards on the lobby become clickable.

Add a Cashout / Exit-game button in the /play-game screen so users can return funds to the local wallet before closing; currently after a successful launch the local wallet reads 0 until backend /api/9wicket/cashout is called (verified via API — cashout works).
critical_code_review_comments: PlayGame.jsx catalog lookup is required even though provider game UID is known — brittle when Mongo catalog is out of sync. Should short-circuit for numeric/known provider UIDs.
Client stores JWT in localStorage.user_token, but PlayGame also checks 'token' and 'accessToken' fallbacks — pick one canonical key to avoid drift.

server/routes/nineWicketRoutes.js: /health returns providerCheck with attempted:false when ping=false. Consider omitting the providerCheck object entirely or adding an explicit `skipped:true` flag for cleaner API contract.
CORS fix (origin:true, credentials:true) reflects any origin — acceptable for this preview but for production consider an allow-list backed by env var.

success_rate.frontend: ~66% (lobby load + login work; /play-game/:gameId fails without ?uid=; game launch works with ?uid=)

seed_data_creation: None. demo01 already existed; balance reset to 2000 by seed script per README.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid — do not re-test unless server code changes. Focus next iteration on verifying the /play-game/:gameId fix (should launch without needing ?uid=). Note: after each successful launch, demo01's local balance drops to ~1990 and the credited amount stays in the 9Wicket provider wallet until POST /api/9wicket/cashout is called. Re-seed with `cd bajiman-main/server && node scripts/seedTestUser.js` if balance is exhausted. Provider IP is currently whitelisted; if provider tests start failing with ipWhitelisted:false, the provider has to be contacted to re-whitelist this server's egress IP or OUTBOUND_PROXY_URL must be configured.
rca_of_the_issue: PlayGame.jsx lines 89-102 unconditionally perform `GET /api/global/client/play-game/:gameId` when `?uid=` is absent. In this environment the games collection in MongoDB is empty (only demo01 user + settings were seeded programmatically), so this endpoint returns HTTP 404 with body {success:false, message:'Game not found'}. axios throws, control transfers to the catch block, `error?.response?.data?.message` ('Game not found') is displayed, and the actual `/api/9wicket/launch` POST never fires. Direct curl to /api/9wicket/launch with {game_uid:'11539',amount:10} + Bearer token succeeds (200, sessionId+gameUrl issued), confirming the backend is healthy. Mitigation: wrap the lookup in try/catch and fall back to using route param as game_uid, OR seed the game record.
